text: 10 OVERDOSAGE In all reported cases of acute overdosage with acamprosate calcium delayed-release tablets (total reported doses of up to 56 grams of acamprosate calcium), the only symptom that could be reasonably associated with acamprosate calcium delayed-release tablets was diarrhea. Hypercalcemia has not been reported in cases of acute overdose. A risk of hypercalcemia should be considered in chronic overdosage only. Treatment of overdose should be symptomatic and supportive.
